title: fix(console): a per-record bulk flow action counts a refused record as refused, with its own message, and stacks no notice
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Fixes #36915

Clause-②: yes (seat ruling: the published `@object-ui/types` `ActionResult` gains a member; L1-a owes a lane-keep L2 review)
Metadata-protocol: none

What is widened: the published `@object-ui/types` gains two optional members, `ActionResult.refusal` and `ActionContext.reportsRefusal`. Nothing existing is narrowed.

## 维护者速读

- 列表页勾选多条记录批量执行流程动作时，被流程拒绝的记录不再算作“成功”：结果框单独显示“被拒绝 N”，每条记录配它自己的拒绝原因，也不再叠出第二个只说一条原因的弹窗；从行菜单执行时的拒绝提示保持原样。
- 修的是客户报告的批量加入营销活动场景：三条选中、两条因退订被拒，结果却显示全部成功。
- 出错时用户最多看到计数或原因展示不对，不会写错数据；改动只在界面一侧，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The per-record bulk path lost the verdict in two places. The refused arm of the flow launch answered `{ success: true, silent: true, handedOff: true }` with no text, and `ObjectGrid`'s `runBulkActionRecord` threw only on `success: false`. Every refused record therefore counted as succeeded. Meanwhile each row's flow handler opened the one shared `FlowRefusalNotice`, and the last write won.

- **`@object-ui/types`**: `ActionResult.refusal?: { message: string }` and `ActionContext.reportsRefusal?: boolean`, both optional.
  - **Why the signal is on `ActionContext` and not on the action:** an action is authored metadata, and a runtime-only key there would widen the authoring face. `ActionContext` is a runtime data bag, never authored or stored. It is passed for exactly one dispatch through `ActionRunner.execute`'s existing `callContext` argument.
- **`flowLaunch.ts`**: `settled()` is the one exit both launch doors (action and trigger) pass through. A run that ended `refused` now also gets `result.refusal = { message }`. The member is set there and not in `judgeFlowLaunch` because `flowResponse.ts` stays read-only under open PR #36845.
- **`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`**: `flowDispatch` opens the notice only when `context.reportsRefusal !== true`. The row menu sets no flag, so its Close-only notice is unchanged.
- **`RecordDetailView.tsx`**: the record page mounts its own `ActionProvider`, which replaces the console's for anything under it, and that provider has its own flow handler. The handler gets the same `context?.reportsRefusal !== true` guard. So a list embedded on a record page, running a per-record bulk flow, opens no stacked notice either. These two handlers are the only places that open `FlowRefusalNotice` (from a grep of `setFlowRefusal`, `FlowRefusalNotice` and `launchConsoleFlow` under `ui/`); both are now guarded.
- **`ObjectGrid.tsx`**: `runBulkActionRecord` dispatches through `runner.execute(action, { reportsRefusal: true })`. On `res.refusal` it resolves with a typed verdict, `{ refusal: { message } }`.
- **`useBulkExecutor.ts`**:
  - **Decision: a refused record is a third category, not a failed row.** `BulkResult.refused` lists `{ id, message }` in selection order, and `succeeded + failed + refused.length === total`. Refused records are kept out of `errors`, the error CSV and the Retry list. They were deliberate answers, and re-running one gets the same answer.
  - **Retry:** failed rows keep their existing Retry. If a failed row is retried and the action now refuses it, the row moves to `refused` and the retry is not counted as a success.
  - `BulkProgress` gains a `refused` count, so the processed counter keeps adding up during a run.
- **`BulkActionDialog.tsx`**: the result reads "Succeeded 1 / 3 · Refused 2". A refused-records list shows each record's name with its own sentence, and offers no Retry button.
- **i18n**: two keys, `grid.bulk.resultRefused` and `grid.bulk.refusedRecords`, added to all ten packs. zh-Hant was regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`. `resultRefused` is listed as count-neutral (`tally`) beside `resultNotConfirmed`.
- One changeset lists every package the diff touches: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

Out of scope: a per-record bulk flow whose run pauses at a screen has the same shape: the row counts as succeeded, and only the last row's screen opens. Triage has it on mailbox #36743, comment 7127841220. Follow-up: none from this PR.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `runBulkActionRecord`. It now calls `runner.execute` with a `callContext`, so the provider's `loading`/`result` state no longer changes for each row of a bulk run. The grid reads neither value.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts`. A refused record's dispatch resolves, and its count is then moved out of `succeeded`. Also read the retry path.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`. The notice condition in each flow handler.

## Tests

Tests on final head `cad0a54043c` (origin/main merged in at `02127147117`): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the record-page flow suites (`RecordDetailView.refusedLaunch-9973`, `flowDoneSuccessMessage-12274`, `flowActionSuccessMessage-12234`, `flowActionDoor-12037`, `flowDroppedFields-33009`, `banCompanion-30205`, `confirmRuntimeParity-5835`, `paramRuntimeParity-6431`, `modalDispatch`), `useConsoleActionRuntime.refusedLaunch-9973`, `objectBulkActionDispatch` and `useBulkExecutor`. Result: Test Files 12 passed (12), Tests 131 passed. `type-check` passed for `@object-ui/app-shell`. On the round-2 head `5f4ae21d567` (origin/main merged in at `49c6bf3d513`), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `packages/types/`, `packages/plugin-grid/`, `packages/i18n/` and 106 consumer files (app-shell flow, refusal, bulk and action-runtime suites; the core ActionRunner and actionKeys pins; plugin-list and plugin-view grid harnesses). Result: Test Files 915 passed (915), Tests 16444 passed, 13 skipped. Type-check passed (`type-check`) for `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

New pins:
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx`, describe "a per-record bulk flow that refuses some records". It runs the real ObjectGrid and ActionProvider with a flow handler.
  - The card's repro: 3 rows, 2 refused with different sentences. The dialog shows "Succeeded 1 / 3" and "Refused 2", each refused row with its own sentence, no error inspector and no Retry, and every dispatch carried `reportsRefusal: true`.
  - A single refused row.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/useBulkExecutor.test.ts`, describe "a refused per-record dispatch is counted apart". It covers the repro at executor level, a single refused record, the no-refusal control, and a failed row whose retry comes back refused.
- `app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.refusedLaunch-9973.test.tsx`, describe "a dispatch that reports refusals itself opens no notice".
  - With the flag: 2 refused and 1 completed open no dialog, and each result carries its own sentence. One refused record also opens no dialog.
  - Control: the row-menu dispatch without the flag still opens the notice.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.refusedLaunch-9973.test.tsx`, describe "record-page flow handler honours reportsRefusal".
  - With the flag: no dialog, and the result carries the sentence.
  - Control: without the flag, the notice opens.
- Four existing pins of the refused launch result now also expect `refusal: { message }`; their notice assertions are unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations: each restored by ablation-replace (blob equals HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A1, the hand-off in `runBulkActionRecord`: `if (res.refusal) return …` replaced by a marker. The grid describe went red, 2 failed ("Unable to find … Succeeded 1 / 3" and "Succeeded 0 / 1").
- A2, the refusal member in `flowLaunch.ts`: `return withRefusal(launch)` replaced by `return launch`. `refusedLaunch-9973` went red, 4 failed.
- A3, the no-notice signal in `flowDispatch`: the `reportsRefusal` condition removed. 2 failed: the card-repro and single-record no-notice pins. The row-menu control stayed green.
- A4, the same guard in `RecordDetailView`'s flow handler, removed. 1 failed (the flag pin), 5 passed, the control among them.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/app-shell` has 2405 test files. Locally I narrowed it to the 106 files that read the changed modules (`flowLaunch`, `useConsoleActionRuntime`, `FlowRefusalNotice`, `ActionResult`, the bulk executor and dialog). CI's `Test UI` runs the whole package.
- Two derived gates hit my local 300 s timeout and are NOT MEASURED locally: `check:query-options-erasure` and `check:type-check-debt`. CI's required jobs run both.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is a private package; it is still listed in the changeset, as sibling changesets do.
- The per-record bulk dispatch now calls `runner.execute` directly. A host-supplied custom `execute` on the action context, and that context's `loading`/`result` state, is therefore skipped for bulk runs. The only custom `execute` in the repo, `RelatedList`'s enlarged grid, declares no `bulkActions`, so nothing reaches this path today.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx -t 'objectstack#36915'`. Expect 2 passed: the card's repro reading "Succeeded 1 / 3 · Refused 2" with both sentences, and the single refused record.

The other 2 timed out at 300 s (exit 124) and are NOT MEASURED: check:query-options-erasure and check:type-check-debt. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` under `ui/` reported 0 new citations.
